trustBasis.signerIdentity: The parent independently observed OpenAI Team ID 2DC432GLL2 on an existing vendor-signed Codex on this Mac and supplied it as a required audit input. The release feed does not supply the trusted signer identity.

releaseWorkflow.inspection: Read as text only. The release workflow signs macOS binaries and verifies the architecture and strict codesign validity of executables in direct archives.

installer.inspection: Read as text only. Its codex-package_SHA256SUMS input covers codex-package assets, not the two exact native codex archives audited here.

method: Downloaded each exact native .tar.gz outside the repo. Required the recorded Content-Length when present, enforced the exact size as a streaming byte limit, and rejected a short or oversized response.
Required the archive SHA-256 to equal the fixed expected digest during download. Re-read each archive with Python hashlib and /usr/bin/shasum before opening it with tarfile.

Parsed each authenticated archive as a stream. Rejected absolute paths, parent traversal, links, special files, duplicate executables, and unexpected regular files. Bounded member count and total uncompressed size.
Copied only the exact regular-file executable into a new mode-0600 file outside the repo. Did not apply archive permissions or extract links.

Computed SHA-256 over the exact executable bytes during the copy, re-read the file with hashlib, and cross-checked with /usr/bin/shasum. Rechecked the digest after codesign inspection and verification.
Read the Mach-O header as data to require a 64-bit MH_EXECUTE file with the exact target CPU type.
Inspected codesign -dv output and required strict codesign verification with an Apple-anchored requirement and independently pinned OpenAI Team ID 2DC432GLL2.
Assessed Gatekeeper with /usr/sbin/spctl as a read-only OS inspection. Recorded both standalone-CLI rejections without claiming Gatekeeper acceptance.
